scite.title: MTLQ-ViT: Multi-granularity Tail-enhanced Logarithmic Quantization for Vision Transformers
GCQ-ViT: Group-Aware Collaborative Post-Training Quantization for Vision Transformers

gcq.summary: Post-LayerNorm activation grouping, displaced logarithmic softmax quantization, and dimension-aware empirical mean error correction. Reported experiments use ViT/DeiT/Swin and Swin detection/segmentation on RTX 3090, not SAM3 or SM75.
gcq.implementation_limit: No Github link found in the inspected article. No verified SM75 integer-kernel implementation or end-to-end latency result. Group-dependent K scales need different GEMM accumulation support.

bc.read: Paper abstract and official BiasCompensation implementation
bc.summary: Accumulates the mean difference between floating and quantized outputs over calibration batches, retaining the output-channel axes. Handles whether the observed quantized output already includes compensation.
bc.next_hypothesis: Empirical output-mean correction can include activation quantization error omitted by the current weight-only formula. This is a hypothesis for a subsequent calibration-only experiment, not implemented or validated here.
